<solution_file path="src/t02_load_eurostat.py">
import pandas as pd
import json

# Load selected indicators
selected_indicators_df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t01_selected_indicators.csv')

# Load Eurostat API configuration
with open('inputs/eurostat/sample_api_config.json') as f:
    api_config = json.load(f)

# Load sample Eurostat city values
eurostat_city_values_df = pd.read_csv('inputs/eurostat/eurostat_city_values_sample.csv')

# Merge selected indicators with Eurostat city values
merged_df = pd.merge(eurostat_city_values_df, selected_indicators_df, on='indicator_id')

# Select required columns
required_columns = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year', 'indicator_id', 'indicator_name', 'value', 'unit']
merged_df = merged_df[required_columns]

# Drop duplicate rows
merged_df.drop_duplicates(subset=['city_id', 'year', 'indicator_id'], keep='first', inplace=True)

# Ensure numeric value entries
merged_df['value'] = pd.to_numeric(merged_df['value'], errors='coerce')

# Write raw Eurostat data to CSV
merged_df.to_csv('outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>
